inputs.text: They’re using a parliamentary briefing to make Terry Pheto the face of an alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission scandal. That doesn’t prove guilt; it looks like a carefully staged way to steer attention toward one public figure while the institutions involved control the story. The claims surfaced at the Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, but a headline and an SIU probe are not the same thing as the full truth.
